scope: Public closed-candle receiver, raw-byte receipts, restart integrity, finite liquidity snapshots and independent GitHub retention checks; no strategy/hypothesis activation
transport: Allowlisted HTTPS GETs to data-api.binance.vision, no API keys, credentials, trading or account endpoints; bounded response sizes and request counts
closure: Only UTC-aligned REST klines with exact inclusive close, valid geometry, positive or explicitly flagged zero volume, and close-exclusive <= an earlier exchange serverTime minus1000ms; local clock must also be compatible
unknown_times: REST publication time stays null; request/receipt/closure-confirmation/registry-ingest/remote-retention timestamps remain distinct
integrity: Reuse P1-08C Registry as sole normalized-evidence/candidate store; append-only raw transport batches bind all receipts and checkpoints; no overwrite, no silently repaired pending transaction
restart: Validate all prior raw hashes, normalization links, registry chain and pinned checkpoint before new I/O; pending or drift fails closed. Recovery uses verified external snapshot into a new directory; re-fetched bars get current receipts, never backdated
quality: Record outages, rate limits, source errors, gaps, duplicates, revisions, open bars, zero volume, invalid data, clock anomalies and collection lag; unavailable evidence blocks downstream readiness
liquidity: BTC/ETH L1 and depth20 only, distinct receipt times; visible spread/depth do not replace fixed5/15bps slippage and do not prove executable prices
external_retention: Separate GitHub Actions verification job downloads the capture artifact, checks platform digest, raw and registry checkpoints, records platform metadata and publishes an independently checkable retention artifact; ordinary GitHub artifacts are expiring/admin-deletable, not WORM or legal timestamping
real_acceptance: Public BTC/ETH closed1H plus completed4H/1D when available; repeated/restarted processes; actual GitHub retention and a pinned-parent subsequent run when supported; unavailable network stays explicit, never replaced by synthetic success
synthetic_acceptance: Separate fixture-only failures for open/future/invalid data, disconnect429, duplicate/revision/gap, clock rollback, drift, crash/pending and restored snapshot; never count as real forward evidence
ongoing_collection: Bounded data-only runs with verified parent snapshots, suitable for scheduled invocation; no unattended activation or default-branch changes; GitHub nondefault-branch scheduling and retention limitations must be disclosed
